cohort: The study included 48 women with severe preeclampsia, 16 with mild preeclampsia, 22 normotensive pregnant women, and 20 non-pregnant women.
finding: GPIbalpha levels were significantly lower in severe preeclampsia compared to other groups, and significantly increased 72 hours after cesarean section in severe preeclampsia patients.
mod_finding: In severe preeclampsia patients, GPIbalpha levels were significantly higher 72 hours after cesarean section compared to preoperative levels.
